historicalAggregateAccounting.meaning: 333576240 is a sampled multi-file delta, while 330448896 is the final primary-file absolute size. They differ in baseline, file scope and time. WAL can retain repeated changed pages until checkpoint/reset; SHM is coordination overhead; effects is separate bookkeeping. No exact historical last-sample WAL/primary decomposition survives in the available compact report.

historicalSelectedGrowthCounts.meaning: The persistentNativeCounts/persistentNativeDigest TABLES list selects twelve tables, not the complete schema. It omits context_revisions, events, inputs, sessions, workspaces, session_controls, session_sequences and many other DB23 tables. Row counts and that selected digest are not byte attribution or an all-table census; the recorded historical whole-primary-file hash is a distinct evidence reference.

contextSnapshot.fact: When the plan binding changes, ContextRevision.text receives JSON.stringify(plan.messages), with selected sourceIds and a content digest.

journalDuplicate.fact: putContextRevision inserts the full serialized ContextRevision in context_revisions and appends its full context to the context.revision.recorded session event.

schemaOmission.fact: context_revisions is a durable table and is absent from the historical twelve-table growth selection.

causalSourceInference.inference: Successive snapshots of growing selected model history can repeat earlier message bytes in context_revisions, then repeat the complete revision in session_events. This is a concrete growth mechanism, not a measured allocation ranking of the unavailable retained DB. Actual selected-context bounds and workload determine growth.

tableSubsetSelection.fact: One shared twelve-table list selects the fixture count/data digest subset.

unmeasuredHistoricalAttribution.reason: Original primary/WAL/SHM/effects and original raw /tmp report are absent. No retained database connection or dbstat query was made. Historical digests are recorded references, not newly verified contents.

inspector.admission: Caller must establish a closed snapshot; refuses missing/nonregular primary, nonempty WAL or rollback journal before SQLite open. Uses Python SQLite URI mode=ro&immutable=1 plus query_only/trusted_schema=OFF. Refuses schema objects shadowing dbstat. Never Engine/DatabaseSync/checkpoint/VACUUM/CREATE dbstat.
inspector.beforeAfter: SHA256, st_size bytes, inode, device and mtimeNs for primary/WAL/SHM/journal and effects/WAL/SHM/journal. Missing files carry null metadata. Reads may change atime; atime equality is not claimed. Hashing enforces the byte ceiling both from initial stat and streamed bytes.
inspector.logical: All ordinary schema tables are counted, all stored columns summed by length(CAST(column AS BLOB)); data column byte totals separate. These textual serialized column lengths are distinct from SQLite record payload.
inspector.physical: Existing eponymous dbstat aggregates leaf/internal/overflow allocated/payload/unused pages, maps indexes to owning tables, and reconciles freelist and unattributed bytes. Compile option and unavailable/error states explicit; no virtual table is created.
inspector.privacy: Schema table/column/index names, aggregate counts/bytes and digests only. Event/document category values and stored identities/content are not printed; known source event names can be matched using categorySha256.

sqliteRuntimeCapability.scope: separate in-memory capability probe, not the missing historical DB

inspector.revisionSamples: At most first8 plus last8 numeric revision groups across all sessions; reports counts/data byte sums only, not owner IDs or raw plan/event text. Optional malformed/unavailable JSON revision extraction does not invent a value.

limitations: Historical per-table attribution remains unavailable: all original retained companions and raw /tmp report are absent.
Fresh native fixture is bounded and separate; its table ranking cannot be scaled to the original30-minute artifact.
Caller-established closure is required: immutable ignores SQLite locks; before/after digests cannot rule out transient concurrent changes.
Serialized column/data bytes, dbstat record/index payload bytes, st_size file lengths and filesystem allocation are distinct; filesystem allocated blocks were not measured.
No leak-rate, whole-engine/desktop/provider acceptance, or longer-soak conclusion is added.

freshNativeComparison.scope: Separate preserved twelve-run native ScriptedProvider fixture at NEXT baseline/candidate; no original30-minute fixture rerun or historical DB reconstruction.

sourcePins.baselineProvenance: Exact f695 parent checkout compiled runtime captured before integration; retained capture.json and runtime graph manifest establish source provenance.

revisionSamplesBoth.meaning: Numeric revision groups aggregate across sessions. The twelve-run fixture has one context row and one corresponding recorded event per group; no owner identity/content is included.

freshNativeComparison.finding: The fresh fixture confirms increasing context snapshot sizes and a matching full-context event copy. Context rows plus recorded events account for1590142 serialized data-column bytes. This supports the source mechanism in this fresh fixture, not historical330448896-byte per-table allocation.
freshNativeComparison.optimizationScope: Baseline/candidate durable row content, logical bytes and allocated pages are equal. Optimization targets repeated write-side JSON serialization CPU/temporary strings; no measured storage or read-memory reduction is claimed.
